5.2.2.2.2 CAN Interface
Detection
There is no timeout detection by CanIf
Reaction
There is no reaction performed by CanIf
Report
The CanIf does not report any timeout event to the upper layers.
Recovery
The recovery is triggered by the CAN State Manager:
• CanIf_SetControllerMode(Controller, CANIF_CS_STARTED).
• Can_InitController(Controller, *Config).
• Can_SetControllerMode (Controller, CAN_T_STARTED).
